learning_objective.text_en: To be able to use perpendicular bisectors (midpoint joined to opposite vertex) to find the centre of gravity of a triangle (centroid). Understand the meaning of inscribed and circumscribed circles in relation to triangles and bisectors.
learning_objective.text_zh: 能够使用垂直平分线（中点连接到相对顶点）找到三角形的重心。理解内接圆和外接圆与三角形和平分线的关系。
